agent_constraints: Separate observations, modeling assumptions, uncertainty, and conclusions.
Do not invent experiments, measurements, sources, or live judge interactions.
A different teammate must review the exact rendered deck before submission.

advice_scope: time allocation within the rule card

opening_discussion.purpose: Coach exits permanently after the single turn-0 blind brief.

competition_format: Work as an IYPT team preparing an original investigation of a published open physics problem. Build a clear presentation supported by theory, reproducible experiments or simulations, uncertainty analysis, and citations. During a live Physics Fight, outside communication is forbidden. This benchmark grades the deck only and does not simulate the Reporter/Opponent/Reviewer exchange.
timeline: Research occurs before the tournament and live fight timing is role-specific; the benchmark turn budget is a proxy.
collaboration_protocol: The team jointly researches the published problems and prepares presentations for Physics Fights.

evaluation_criteria: Score the rendered presentation deck with the research-report rubric. Keep this normalized artifact score separate from official 1-10 juror grades and Physics Fight coefficients.
